notes:
Rejected at vision walk #4 (2026-04-27). Draft is directionally on-canon (agents-as-protagonists, named files, builder lexicon) but fails 7 substantive issues that the existing 8-failure-mode framework did not catch. A separate framework-update is being raised to add those modes.

ISSUES (operator's verbatim concerns, structured for next draft cycle):

1. NARRATIVE-FLATNESS / NO ESSAY-SHAPE. Reads as a changelog, not a dev-log. Dev-log posts must have essay structure: hook → introduction → body → conclusion. Each post must give the reader a reason to come back, click your profile, and find the others. Current draft jumps straight to changes without arc.

2. NO INTRODUCTION ON FIRST PUBLISH. This is the very first dev-log post ever — readers have not been told what swarm-manager is, what initiative-agents are, or why this matters. First publish must introduce: the project, the operator-as-engineer, why this is exciting. Subsequent posts can drop the full intro for a one-line refresher. Need infrastructure to track which scenarios have been introduced in published posts.

3. NO PERSONAL VOICE / BUILDER IDENTITY. Should feel like a software engineer talking about what they built — grounded hype/excitement, real human energy. Current draft reads as corporate-changelog third-person despite naming agents. STRATEGY.md voice samples include 'first person, conversational' but the draft does not embody it.

4. INTERNAL-NUMBERING LEAKAGE. 'p8' appears in 4 of 6 tweets. Means nothing externally. Internal pass numbers are an internal artifact. The only sequential numbering that matters externally is the dev-log post itself ('this is post #1, more to come' / 'previously…').

5. CHAR-COUNT CONSTRAINT OVER-APPLIED. Draft caps every tweet at <280 chars. X allows long posts now (with show-more gating). The hook tweet should be short to grab attention. Body tweets should be longer to carry substance and detail. Char-count limits should be position-aware, not uniform.

6. WHAT-WITHOUT-WHY FRAMING. Tweet 3: 'agentmanager/resolve.go (52 lines + 202 test lines).' Tweet 4: 'backlog/retry.go (178 + 186 test). execution/retry.go (240 + 281 test).' These are *what* changed without *why* it matters. Reader has no reason to care about line counts. Each shown change must tie to a concrete reason-to-care, ideally connected to prior dev-log narrative.

7. NO INTER-POST LINKAGE. No reference to previous dev-log; no path for readers to find others. Posts must link to the previous one in the series (URL in last reply, or 'previously: <url>' line). Operator manually posts due to X bot rules; URL must be pasted back into publish-log.jsonl after posting and used as previous_post_url for next post.

META-SIGNAL (also being raised separately as framework-update):

Marketing-contrarian's 8 failure modes did not catch any of these issues. The framework is structurally incomplete. Four new failure modes are being proposed: narrative-flatness, internal-vocabulary-leakage, missing-introduction-on-first-mention, what-without-why.

decision: Add 4 new failure modes to marketing-contrarian's framework: narrative-flatness, internal-vocabulary-leakage, missing-introduction-on-first-mention, what-without-why
rationale:
Operator-raised at vision walk #4 (2026-04-27) following rejection of dec-1777232229870857566.

The marketing-contrarian framework currently scores against 8 modes (hype-drift, voice-drift, hallucinated-engagement, paywall-framing, OSS-leak-framing, coverage-gap-ignorance, acquisition-only, capability-workaround-no-gap). Contrarian scored dec-1777232229870857566 clean on all 8 — yet the operator rejected the draft for 7 substantive issues the framework did not catch. The framework is structurally incomplete on dev-log narrative shape.

PROPOSED ADDITIONS:

(1) NARRATIVE-FLATNESS. Draft reads as changelog or atomic-tweet list rather than essay-shape (hook -> introduction -> body -> conclusion). Detection: thread / post lacks any of: hook designed for click-through, introduction grounding the reader, body that builds substance, conclusion giving reason to return. Revision-that-would-pass: rewrite into essay-shape with each component identifiable. Distinct from voice-drift (which is word/phrase-level corporate-marketer language); this is structural shape.

(2) INTERNAL-VOCABULARY-LEAKAGE. Published copy uses internal artifact names (e.g. p8, round-002, milestone-3, internal batch ids, internal codenames) without translation. Detection: any token that does not parse for a reader unfamiliar with the project. Revision-that-would-pass: replace with audience-facing description; if sequence matters, use external dev-log post number (post #N in series). Distinct from hype-drift (feature-claim overreach); this is vocabulary obscurity unrelated to claims.

(3) MISSING-INTRODUCTION-ON-FIRST-MENTION. Draft refers to a scenario / agent / named file / internal concept by name that has no prior entry in shared/published-scenario-mentions.jsonl for the target audience, AND the draft does not introduce it. Detection: subject lookup returns no prior mention AND the name appears without a one-sentence introduction. Revision-that-would-pass: add introduction (what it is, why it exists, what it does) before first naming.

(4) WHAT-WITHOUT-WHY. Draft lists changes / line counts / commit refs without a why-it-mattered framing tied to broader narrative. Detection: change shown lacks any clause connecting it to reader-relevant impact, prior post setup, or vision. Revision-that-would-pass: add the why; or drop the change (only show changes that actually matter).

REFERENCES:
- Rejected dec-1777232229870857566 — rejection notes contain the 7 substantive issues + meta-signal.
- knw-1777300275163941898 in shared/knowledge.jsonl — dev-log-narrative-principles knowledge entry.
- docs/marketing/strategy/STRATEGY.md updated: 'Dev-log narrative principles' section + Sample 5 (first-publish intro burden).
- shared/TEAM.md updated: documented published-scenario-mentions.jsonl and published-improvements-log.jsonl shapes; extended publish-log shape with post_url + previous_post_url + series_id + post_index_in_series.
- shared/published-scenario-mentions.jsonl + shared/published-improvements-log.jsonl created (empty, append-only).
- members/oss-advertiser/HEARTBEAT.md step 6 expanded with first-mention pass, progression pass, narrative-shape pass, voice + builder identity, inter-post linkage, no-internal-numbering, char-count-rule sub-steps.

OPERATOR AUTHORITY: framework-update is owned by marketing-contrarian per TEAM.md, but this raise is operator-driven because the gap was discovered at the vision walk rather than by the contrarian heartbeat. Marketing-contrarian's next heartbeat should adopt these 4 modes alongside the existing 8 once accepted. Recommend acceptance.
